watch.summary: A Rocket League player uses voice chat to feign helplessness to play mind games with his opponent, then immediately scores a quick goal.

beats.what: Streamer worries his opponent might be a high rank.
Opponent scores, making the streamer look weak.
Streamer decides to play mind games by talking in voice chat.
Streamer tells the opponent over mic that he feels doomed.
Streamer immediately steals the ball and scores, celebrating his trickery.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Can't be doomed when I'm good, come on!
watch.why: The comedy stems from the quick subversion of expectation when the streamer acts helpless over voice chat only to immediately score. His triumphant boast right after hitting the shot delivers a satisfying punchline.
